implementation: Capture canonical root once per cached candidate view; explicit checks capture it afresh.
Avoid repeated source normalization only for the strict single-component filename grammar; all other inputs use the original public normalizer.
Use string parents only for normalized POSIX sources without a colon; colon-containing sources retain native Path semantics.
Private fallback retains absolute/Windows-anchor rejection before NUL rejection, followed by full resolution and containment.
Only POSIX ordinary single-component root leaves with successful regular-file lstat and no reparse flag can return eligibility directly.
All Windows paths, aliases, nonregular leaves, complex sources and metadata errors retain full target/parent resolution and marker handling.
All 19 original read/path/file-fact/marker definitions are byte-identical; no marker or stat-result cache was added.
limitations: Candidate snapshots are not atomic filesystem sandboxes. Fresh content reads keep the original boundary and block a leaf retargeted to an external target, including cache hits.
performance_status: Await root-owned quiet budget feedback and subsequent validation; no native Windows pass claimed here.
